title: [29.x][ALL-E] Item charge assignment update Error on sales order when there is no Price.  "Sorry, we just updated this page. Reopen it and try again." when running in SaaS
summary: Item charge assignment on sales orders now refreshes record set after bulk updates to prevent page synchronization errors when assigning by amount.
key_points: Calls FindSet() to refresh the sales assignment record set after clearing fields with ModifyAll
Suggesting item charge assignment By Amount no longer fails with 'Sorry, we just updated this page' in SaaS
Covers orders where one item line has no price
Regression tests added in W1, CA and US test layers
quote: Refresh the record set with FindSet() after the bulk updates.
